facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at B-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on B-8201, D-8210 and PSV-8201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on B-8201, D-8210 and PSV-8201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically draining, venting and warming through steam systems. B-8201 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 April 2023 a regulatory notice was issued concerning B-8201, D-8210 and PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following a breakdown response.
